\NormalTok{                q}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\NormalTok{q}\OperatorTok{+}\BaseNTok{2\textquotesingle{}d1}\OperatorTok{;}
            \KeywordTok{end}
            \DecValTok{S\_BIT:} \KeywordTok{begin}
                \KeywordTok{case} \OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{q}\OperatorTok{)}
                    \BaseNTok{2\textquotesingle{}d0}\OperatorTok{:} \KeywordTok{begin}\NormalTok{ sioc}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b0}\OperatorTok{;}
                                \KeywordTok{if} \OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{bitc}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\BaseNTok{4\textquotesingle{}d7}\OperatorTok{)}\NormalTok{ siod\_low }\OperatorTok{\textless{}=} \OperatorTok{\textasciitilde{}}\NormalTok{byte\_sel}\OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{7}\OperatorTok{{-}}\NormalTok{bitc}\OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{2}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{]];}
                                \KeywordTok{else}\NormalTok{            siod\_low }\OperatorTok{\textless{}=} \BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b0}\OperatorTok{;}
                          \KeywordTok{end}
                    \BaseNTok{2\textquotesingle{}d1}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ sioc}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b1}\OperatorTok{;}
                    \BaseNTok{2\textquotesingle{}d2}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ sioc}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b1}\OperatorTok{;}
                    \BaseNTok{2\textquotesingle{}d3}\OperatorTok{:} \KeywordTok{begin}\NormalTok{ sioc}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b0}\OperatorTok{;}
                                \KeywordTok{if} \OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{bitc}\OperatorTok{==}\BaseNTok{4\textquotesingle{}d8}\OperatorTok{)} \KeywordTok{begin}
                                    \KeywordTok{if} \OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{bytec}\OperatorTok{==}\BaseNTok{2\textquotesingle{}d2}\OperatorTok{)}\NormalTok{ state}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\NormalTok{S\_STOP}\OperatorTok{;}
                                    \KeywordTok{else} \KeywordTok{begin}\NormalTok{ bytec}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\NormalTok{bytec}\OperatorTok{+}\BaseNTok{2\textquotesingle{}d1}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ bitc}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{;} \KeywordTok{end}
                                \KeywordTok{end} \KeywordTok{else}\NormalTok{ bitc}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\NormalTok{bitc}\OperatorTok{+}\BaseNTok{4\textquotesingle{}d1}\OperatorTok{;}
                          \KeywordTok{end}
                \KeywordTok{endcase}
\NormalTok{                q}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\NormalTok{q}\OperatorTok{+}\BaseNTok{2\textquotesingle{}d1}\OperatorTok{;}
            \KeywordTok{end}
            \DecValTok{S\_STOP:} \KeywordTok{begin}
                \KeywordTok{case} \OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{q}\OperatorTok{)}
                    \BaseNTok{2\textquotesingle{}d0}\OperatorTok{:} \KeywordTok{begin}\NormalTok{ siod\_low}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b1}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ sioc}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b0}\OperatorTok{;} \KeywordTok{end}
                    \BaseNTok{2\textquotesingle{}d1}\OperatorTok{:} \KeywordTok{begin}\NormalTok{ siod\_low}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b1}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ sioc}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b1}\OperatorTok{;} \KeywordTok{end}
                    \BaseNTok{2\textquotesingle{}d2}\OperatorTok{:} \KeywordTok{begin}\NormalTok{ siod\_low}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b0}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ sioc}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b1}\OperatorTok{;} \KeywordTok{end}
                    \BaseNTok{2\textquotesingle{}d3}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ state}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\NormalTok{S\_DELAY}\OperatorTok{;}
                \KeywordTok{endcase}
\NormalTok{                q}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\NormalTok{q}\OperatorTok{+}\BaseNTok{2\textquotesingle{}d1}\OperatorTok{;}
            \KeywordTok{end}
            \DecValTok{S\_DELAY:} \KeywordTok{begin}
\NormalTok{                sioc}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b1}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ siod\_low}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b0}\OperatorTok{;}
                \KeywordTok{if} \OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{q}\OperatorTok{==}\BaseNTok{2\textquotesingle{}d3}\OperatorTok{)} \KeywordTok{begin}
                    \KeywordTok{if} \OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{regc}\OperatorTok{==}\NormalTok{NREGS}\DecValTok{{-}1}\OperatorTok{)}\NormalTok{ state}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\NormalTok{S\_DONE}\OperatorTok{;}
                    \KeywordTok{else} \KeywordTok{begin}\NormalTok{ regc}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\NormalTok{regc}\OperatorTok{+}\BaseNTok{8\textquotesingle{}d1}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ dbg\_reg}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\NormalTok{rom}\OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{regc}\OperatorTok{+}\BaseNTok{8\textquotesingle{}d1}\OperatorTok{)} \OperatorTok{\textgreater{}\textgreater{}} \DecValTok{8}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ state}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\NormalTok{S\_START}\OperatorTok{;} \KeywordTok{end}
                \KeywordTok{end}
\NormalTok{                q}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\NormalTok{q}\OperatorTok{+}\BaseNTok{2\textquotesingle{}d1}\OperatorTok{;}
            \KeywordTok{end}
            \DecValTok{S\_DONE:}\NormalTok{ done}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b1}\OperatorTok{;}
            \KeywordTok{endcase}
        \KeywordTok{end}
    \KeywordTok{end}
\KeywordTok{endmodule}
\OtherTok{\textasciigrave{}default\_nettype wire}
\end{Highlighting}
\end{Shaded}

\subsubsection{\texorpdfstring{\texttt{ov7670\_capture.v}}{ov7670\_capture.v}}\label{ov7670_capture.v}

\begin{Shaded}
\begin{Highlighting}[]
\CommentTok{// ============================================================================}
\CommentTok{// ov7670\_capture.v}
\CommentTok{//}
\CommentTok{// OV7670 camera capture front{-}end for the femto2 SoC (tty\_project\_filter thesis).}
\CommentTok{// Target board: iCESugar v1.5  (Lattice iCE40UP5K{-}SG48)}
\CommentTok{// Wiring:       PMOD2 = pixel data D[7:0],  PMOD3 = clocks/sync/SCCB}
\CommentTok{//}
\CommentTok{// What this module does:}
\CommentTok{//   1) Generates XCLK (\textasciitilde{}24 MHz) to drive the OV7670.}
\CommentTok{//   2) Synchronises PCLK/HREF/VSYNC into the FPGA sysclk domain.}
\CommentTok{//   3) Captures one 8{-}bit pixel byte on each PCLK rising edge while HREF=1.}
\CommentTok{//   4) Combines two consecutive bytes into one 16{-}bit RGB565 pixel.}
\CommentTok{//   5) Emits frame\_start / line\_start pulses for downstream pipeline sync.}
\CommentTok{//}
\CommentTok{// What this module does NOT do (separate modules needed):}
\CommentTok{//   {-} SCCB (I2C{-}like) master to configure the camera at boot}
\CommentTok{//     {-}\textgreater{} implement in   cores/camera/ov7670\_sccb.v}
\CommentTok{//   {-} Line buffering / DMA into RAM for the femto2 to read}
\CommentTok{//     {-}\textgreater{} downstream consumer\textquotesingle{}s job}
\CommentTok{//}
\CommentTok{// Verilog{-}2001 style, written to be readable as a teaching example.}
\CommentTok{// ============================================================================}

\OtherTok{\textasciigrave{}default\_nettype none}

\KeywordTok{module}\NormalTok{ ov7670\_capture \#}\OperatorTok{(}
    \DataTypeTok{parameter} \DataTypeTok{integer}\NormalTok{ SYSCLK\_HZ }\OperatorTok{=} \DecValTok{48}\NormalTok{\_000\_000}\OperatorTok{,}   \CommentTok{// FPGA system clock (Hz)}
    \DataTypeTok{parameter} \DataTypeTok{integer}\NormalTok{ XCLK\_HZ   }\OperatorTok{=} \DecValTok{24}\NormalTok{\_000\_000    }\CommentTok{// target XCLK to camera (Hz)}
\OperatorTok{)} \OperatorTok{(}
    \CommentTok{// {-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-} Clock \& reset {-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}}
    \DataTypeTok{input}  \DataTypeTok{wire}\NormalTok{        sysclk}\OperatorTok{,}                 \CommentTok{// system clock (\textgreater{}= 2 * PCLK)}
    \DataTypeTok{input}  \DataTypeTok{wire}\NormalTok{        rst\_n}\OperatorTok{,}                  \CommentTok{// active{-}low reset}

    \CommentTok{// {-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-} OV7670 pins (cross the PMOD boundary) {-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}}
    \DataTypeTok{input}  \DataTypeTok{wire} \OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{7}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{]}\NormalTok{  cam\_d}\OperatorTok{,}                  \CommentTok{// pixel data byte   (PMOD2)}
    \DataTypeTok{input}  \DataTypeTok{wire}\NormalTok{        cam\_pclk}\OperatorTok{,}               \CommentTok{// pixel clock       (PMOD3, in)}
    \DataTypeTok{input}  \DataTypeTok{wire}\NormalTok{        cam\_href}\OperatorTok{,}               \CommentTok{// line valid        (PMOD3, in)}
    \DataTypeTok{input}  \DataTypeTok{wire}\NormalTok{        cam\_vsync}\OperatorTok{,}              \CommentTok{// frame sync        (PMOD3, in)}
    \DataTypeTok{output} \DataTypeTok{wire}\NormalTok{        cam\_xclk}\OperatorTok{,}               \CommentTok{// FPGA{-}gen\textquotesingle{}d clock  (PMOD3, out, \textasciitilde{}24 MHz)}

    \CommentTok{// {-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-} Pixel stream out (sysclk domain) {-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}}
    \DataTypeTok{output} \DataTypeTok{reg}  \OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{15}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{]}\NormalTok{ pixel\_rgb565}\OperatorTok{,}           \CommentTok{// 16{-}bit RGB565 pixel}
    \DataTypeTok{output} \DataTypeTok{reg}\NormalTok{         pixel\_valid}\OperatorTok{,}            \CommentTok{// 1 sysclk pulse when pixel\_rgb565 is fresh}
    \DataTypeTok{output} \DataTypeTok{reg}\NormalTok{         frame\_start}\OperatorTok{,}            \CommentTok{// pulse at start of every frame}
    \DataTypeTok{output} \DataTypeTok{reg}\NormalTok{         line\_start              }\CommentTok{// pulse at start of every line}
\OperatorTok{);}

    \CommentTok{// ========================================================================}
    \CommentTok{// 1) XCLK generator: divide sysclk down to \textasciitilde{}XCLK\_HZ}
    \CommentTok{// {-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}{-}}
    \CommentTok{// For low{-}jitter operation prefer the iCE40UP5K PLL (SB\_PLL40\_PAD); this}
    \CommentTok{// counter{-}based divider is fine for the OV7670 (it tolerates wide XCLK).}
    \CommentTok{// ========================================================================}
    \DataTypeTok{localparam} \DataTypeTok{integer}\NormalTok{ DIVIDER }\OperatorTok{=} \OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{SYSCLK\_HZ }\OperatorTok{/} \OperatorTok{(}\DecValTok{2}\NormalTok{ * XCLK\_HZ}\OperatorTok{));}   \CommentTok{// toggle every DIVIDER cycles}
    \DataTypeTok{reg} \OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{15}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{]}\NormalTok{ xclk\_cnt}\OperatorTok{;}
    \DataTypeTok{reg}\NormalTok{        xclk\_r}\OperatorTok{;}
    \KeywordTok{always} \OperatorTok{@(}\KeywordTok{posedge}\NormalTok{ sysclk }\DataTypeTok{or} \KeywordTok{negedge}\NormalTok{ rst\_n}\OperatorTok{)} \KeywordTok{begin}
        \KeywordTok{if} \OperatorTok{(!}\NormalTok{rst\_n}\OperatorTok{)} \KeywordTok{begin}
\NormalTok{            xclk\_cnt }\OperatorTok{\textless{}=} \BaseNTok{16\textquotesingle{}d0}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{            xclk\_r   }\OperatorTok{\textless{}=} \BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b0}\OperatorTok{;}
        \KeywordTok{end} \KeywordTok{else} \KeywordTok{if} \OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{xclk\_cnt }\OperatorTok{==}\NormalTok{ DIVIDER}\OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{15}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{]} \OperatorTok{{-}} \DecValTok{1}\OperatorTok{)} \KeywordTok{begin}
\NormalTok{            xclk\_cnt }\OperatorTok{\textless{}=} \BaseNTok{16\textquotesingle{}d0}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{            xclk\_r   }\OperatorTok{\textless{}=} \OperatorTok{\textasciitilde{}}\NormalTok{xclk\_r}\OperatorTok{;}
        \KeywordTok{end} \KeywordTok{else} \KeywordTok{begin}
\NormalTok{            xclk\_cnt }\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\NormalTok{ xclk\_cnt }\OperatorTok{+} \BaseNTok{16\textquotesingle{}d1}\OperatorTok{;}
        \KeywordTok{end}
    \KeywordTok{end}
    \KeywordTok{assign}\NormalTok{ cam\_xclk }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ xclk\_r}\OperatorTok{;}

    \CommentTok{// ========================================================================}
    \CommentTok{// 2) 2{-}FF synchronisers for the camera\textquotesingle{}s async{-}looking inputs}
    \CommentTok{//    (PCLK is technically derived from cam\_xclk, but it returns to us}
    \CommentTok{//     through the camera + cable: treat as async, synchronise it.)}
    \CommentTok{// ========================================================================}
    \DataTypeTok{reg} \OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{1}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{]}\NormalTok{ pclk\_s}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ href\_s}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ vsync\_s}\OperatorTok{;}
    \KeywordTok{always} \OperatorTok{@(}\KeywordTok{posedge}\NormalTok{ sysclk }\DataTypeTok{or} \KeywordTok{negedge}\NormalTok{ rst\_n}\OperatorTok{)} \KeywordTok{begin}
        \KeywordTok{if} \OperatorTok{(!}\NormalTok{rst\_n}\OperatorTok{)} \KeywordTok{begin}
\NormalTok{            pclk\_s  }\OperatorTok{\textless{}=} \BaseNTok{2\textquotesingle{}b00}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{            href\_s  }\OperatorTok{\textless{}=} \BaseNTok{2\textquotesingle{}b00}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{            vsync\_s }\OperatorTok{\textless{}=} \BaseNTok{2\textquotesingle{}b00}\OperatorTok{;}
        \KeywordTok{end} \KeywordTok{else} \KeywordTok{begin}
\NormalTok{            pclk\_s  }\OperatorTok{\textless{}=} \OperatorTok{\{}\NormalTok{pclk\_s }\OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{],}\NormalTok{ cam\_pclk }\OperatorTok{\};}
\NormalTok{            href\_s  }\OperatorTok{\textless{}=} \OperatorTok{\{}\NormalTok{href\_s }\OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{],}\NormalTok{ cam\_href }\OperatorTok{\};}
\NormalTok{            vsync\_s }\OperatorTok{\textless{}=} \OperatorTok{\{}\NormalTok{vsync\_s}\OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{],}\NormalTok{ cam\_vsync}\OperatorTok{\};}
        \KeywordTok{end}
    \KeywordTok{end}
    \DataTypeTok{wire}\NormalTok{ pclk\_now  }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ pclk\_s }\OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{1}\OperatorTok{];}
    \DataTypeTok{wire}\NormalTok{ href\_now  }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ href\_s }\OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{1}\OperatorTok{];}
    \DataTypeTok{wire}\NormalTok{ vsync\_now }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ vsync\_s}\OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{1}\OperatorTok{];}

    \CommentTok{// Edge detection: remember previous value, compare to current.}
    \DataTypeTok{reg}\NormalTok{ pclk\_prev}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ href\_prev}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ vsync\_prev}\OperatorTok{;}
    \KeywordTok{always} \OperatorTok{@(}\KeywordTok{posedge}\NormalTok{ sysclk }\DataTypeTok{or} \KeywordTok{negedge}\NormalTok{ rst\_n}\OperatorTok{)} \KeywordTok{begin}
        \KeywordTok{if} \OperatorTok{(!}\NormalTok{rst\_n}\OperatorTok{)} \KeywordTok{begin}
\NormalTok{            pclk\_prev  }\OperatorTok{\textless{}=} \BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b0}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{            href\_prev  }\OperatorTok{\textless{}=} \BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b0}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{            vsync\_prev }\OperatorTok{\textless{}=} \BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b0}\OperatorTok{;}
        \KeywordTok{end} \KeywordTok{else} \KeywordTok{begin}
\NormalTok{            pclk\_prev  }\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\NormalTok{ pclk\_now}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{            href\_prev  }\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\NormalTok{ href\_now}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{            vsync\_prev }\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\NormalTok{ vsync\_now}\OperatorTok{;}
        \KeywordTok{end}
    \KeywordTok{end}
    \DataTypeTok{wire}\NormalTok{ pclk\_rising  }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{  pclk\_now  }\OperatorTok{\&} \OperatorTok{\textasciitilde{}}\NormalTok{pclk\_prev}\OperatorTok{;}
    \DataTypeTok{wire}\NormalTok{ href\_rising  }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{  href\_now  }\OperatorTok{\&} \OperatorTok{\textasciitilde{}}\NormalTok{href\_prev}\OperatorTok{;}
    \DataTypeTok{wire}\NormalTok{ vsync\_rising }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{  vsync\_now }\OperatorTok{\&} \OperatorTok{\textasciitilde{}}\NormalTok{vsync\_prev}\OperatorTok{;}

    \CommentTok{// ========================================================================}
    \CommentTok{// 3) Byte capture + RGB565 byte{-}pair combiner}
    \CommentTok{//    The OV7670 sends each 16{-}bit RGB565 pixel as two bytes back{-}to{-}back:}
    \CommentTok{//        byte 0 (upper) = \{ R[4:0] , G[5:3] \}}
    \CommentTok{//        byte 1 (lower) = \{ G[2:0] , B[4:0] \}}
    \CommentTok{//    Align at the start of every line via href\_rising.}
    \CommentTok{// ========================================================================}
    \DataTypeTok{reg}\NormalTok{       byte\_phase}\OperatorTok{;}     \CommentTok{// 0 {-}\textgreater{} waiting for upper byte ; 1 {-}\textgreater{} waiting for lower byte}
    \DataTypeTok{reg} \OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{7}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{]}\NormalTok{ upper\_byte}\OperatorTok{;}

    \KeywordTok{always} \OperatorTok{@(}\KeywordTok{posedge}\NormalTok{ sysclk }\DataTypeTok{or} \KeywordTok{negedge}\NormalTok{ rst\_n}\OperatorTok{)} \KeywordTok{begin}
        \KeywordTok{if} \OperatorTok{(!}\NormalTok{rst\_n}\OperatorTok{)} \KeywordTok{begin}
\NormalTok{            byte\_phase   }\OperatorTok{\textless{}=} \BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b0}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{            upper\_byte   }\OperatorTok{\textless{}=} \BaseNTok{8\textquotesingle{}h00}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{            pixel\_rgb565 }\OperatorTok{\textless{}=} \BaseNTok{16\textquotesingle{}h0000}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{            pixel\_valid  }\OperatorTok{\textless{}=} \BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b0}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{            frame\_start  }\OperatorTok{\textless{}=} \BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b0}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{            line\_start   }\OperatorTok{\textless{}=} \BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b0}\OperatorTok{;}
        \KeywordTok{end} \KeywordTok{else} \KeywordTok{begin}
            \CommentTok{// Single{-}cycle output pulses by default.}
\NormalTok{            pixel\_valid }\OperatorTok{\textless{}=} \BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b0}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{            frame\_start }\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\NormalTok{ vsync\_rising}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{            line\_start  }\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\NormalTok{ href\_rising}\OperatorTok{;}

            \CommentTok{// Re{-}align at the start of each line so we never get half{-}pixels.}
            \KeywordTok{if} \OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{href\_rising}\OperatorTok{)}
\NormalTok{                byte\_phase }\OperatorTok{\textless{}=} \BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b0}\OperatorTok{;}

            \CommentTok{// Sample data on PCLK rising edge while the line is active.}
            \KeywordTok{if} \OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{pclk\_rising }\OperatorTok{\&\&}\NormalTok{ href\_now}\OperatorTok{)} \KeywordTok{begin}
                \KeywordTok{if} \OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{byte\_phase }\OperatorTok{==} \BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b0}\OperatorTok{)} \KeywordTok{begin}
\NormalTok{                    upper\_byte }\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\NormalTok{ cam\_d}\OperatorTok{;}
                \KeywordTok{end} \KeywordTok{else} \KeywordTok{begin}
\NormalTok{                    pixel\_rgb565 }\OperatorTok{\textless{}=} \OperatorTok{\{}\NormalTok{upper\_byte}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ cam\_d}\OperatorTok{\};}
\NormalTok{                    pixel\_valid  }\OperatorTok{\textless{}=} \BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b1}\OperatorTok{;}
                \KeywordTok{end}
\NormalTok{                byte\_phase }\OperatorTok{\textless{}=} \OperatorTok{\textasciitilde{}}\NormalTok{byte\_phase}\OperatorTok{;}
            \KeywordTok{end}
        \KeywordTok{end}
    \KeywordTok{end}

\KeywordTok{endmodule}

\OtherTok{\textasciigrave{}default\_nettype wire}
\end{Highlighting}
\end{Shaded}

\subsubsection{\texorpdfstring{\texttt{rgb565\_to\_gray.v}}{rgb565\_to\_gray.v}}\label{rgb565_to_gray.v}

\begin{Shaded}
\begin{Highlighting}[]
\CommentTok{// ============================================================================}
\CommentTok{// rgb565\_to\_gray.v}
\CommentTok{// Convierte un pixel RGB565 (el que sale de ov7670\_capture) a gris de 8 bits.}
\CommentTok{// Luma aproximada SIN multiplicar (estilo Diana, solo sumas y shifts):}
\CommentTok{//     Y = (R + 2*G + B) \textgreater{}\textgreater{} 2}
\CommentTok{// RGB565:  [15:11]=R5  [10:5]=G6  [4:0]=B5  (se expanden a 8 bits replicando MSBs).}
\CommentTok{// ============================================================================}
\OtherTok{\textasciigrave{}default\_nettype none}
\KeywordTok{module}\NormalTok{ rgb565\_to\_gray }\OperatorTok{(}
    \DataTypeTok{input}  \DataTypeTok{wire} \OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{15}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{]}\NormalTok{ rgb565}\OperatorTok{,}
    \DataTypeTok{output} \DataTypeTok{wire} \OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{7}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{]}\NormalTok{  gray}
\OperatorTok{);}
    \DataTypeTok{wire} \OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{4}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{]}\NormalTok{ r5 }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ rgb565}\OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{15}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{11}\OperatorTok{];}
    \DataTypeTok{wire} \OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{5}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{]}\NormalTok{ g6 }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ rgb565}\OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{10}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{5}\OperatorTok{];}
    \DataTypeTok{wire} \OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{4}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{]}\NormalTok{ b5 }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ rgb565}\OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{4}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{];}
    \CommentTok{// expandir a 8 bits (replicar los bits altos para llenar el rango)}
    \DataTypeTok{wire} \OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{7}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{]}\NormalTok{ r8 }\OperatorTok{=} \OperatorTok{\{}\NormalTok{r5}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ r5}\OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{4}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{2}\OperatorTok{]\};}
    \DataTypeTok{wire} \OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{7}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{]}\NormalTok{ g8 }\OperatorTok{=} \OperatorTok{\{}\NormalTok{g6}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ g6}\OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{5}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{4}\OperatorTok{]\};}
    \DataTypeTok{wire} \OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{7}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{]}\NormalTok{ b8 }\OperatorTok{=} \OperatorTok{\{}\NormalTok{b5}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ b5}\OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{4}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{2}\OperatorTok{]\};}
    \CommentTok{// Y = (R + 2G + B) \textgreater{}\textgreater{} 2   {-}\textgreater{} cabe en 10 bits, tomamos los 8 altos}
    \DataTypeTok{wire} \OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{9}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{]}\NormalTok{ sum }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ r8 }\OperatorTok{+} \OperatorTok{\{}\NormalTok{g8}\OperatorTok{,} \BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b0}\OperatorTok{\}} \OperatorTok{+}\NormalTok{ b8}\OperatorTok{;}     \CommentTok{// g8\textless{}\textless{}1 = \{g8,1\textquotesingle{}b0\}}
    \KeywordTok{assign}\NormalTok{ gray }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ sum}\OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{9}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{2}\OperatorTok{];}
\KeywordTok{endmodule}
\OtherTok{\textasciigrave{}default\_nettype wire}
\end{Highlighting}
\end{Shaded}

\subsubsection{\texorpdfstring{\texttt{lcd\_ili9341\_top.v}}{lcd\_ili9341\_top.v}}\label{lcd_ili9341_top.v}

\begin{Shaded}
\begin{Highlighting}[]
\CommentTok{// lcd\_ili9341\_top.v — DRIVER del PMOD TFTLCD (ILI9341, SPI) AUTOCONTENIDO para ASIC}
\CommentTok{//   sky130 (fase 8).}
\CommentTok{// El otro extremo de la cadena: toma un STREAM de pixeles en gris (pix\_gray, con}
\CommentTok{//   handshake pix\_next)}
\CommentTok{// y lo pinta en la pantalla por SPI. Hace: (1) delay de arranque, (2) secuencia de}
\CommentTok{//   INIT del ILI9341,}
\CommentTok{// (3) por cada cuadro CASET/RASET/RAMWR, (4) FILL: 240x320 pixeles RGB565 (2 bytes}
\CommentTok{//   c/u).}
\CommentTok{// Logica de SPI + ROM de comandos reusada del driver verificado en FPGA}
\CommentTok{//   (cam\_femto\_display.v).}
\CommentTok{//}
\CommentTok{//   DECISIONES ASIC (para la tesis):}
\CommentTok{// {-} SIN framebuffer interno: los pixeles vienen de AFUERA (del filtro). La memoria se}
\CommentTok{//   queda fuera}
\CommentTok{// {-}\textgreater{} el driver es "pegamento" barato. Handshake: pix\_next pulsa cuando consume un}
\CommentTok{//   pixel.}
\CommentTok{// {-} RESET EXPLICITO: el original usaba valores \textasciigrave{}initial\textasciigrave{} (valen en FPGA por el}
\CommentTok{//   bitstream, NO en ASIC}
\CommentTok{//     donde los FF arrancan aleatorios). Aqui todo el estado se inicializa con rst\_n.}
\CommentTok{//   {-} gris {-}\textgreater{} RGB565 en grises: \{g[7:3], g[7:2], g[7:3]\}.}
\OtherTok{\textasciigrave{}default\_nettype none}
\KeywordTok{module}\NormalTok{ lcd\_ili9341\_top \#}\OperatorTok{(}
    \DataTypeTok{parameter} \DataTypeTok{integer}\NormalTok{ BOOT\_DELAY }\OperatorTok{=} \DecValTok{1}\NormalTok{\_800\_000}\OperatorTok{,}   \CommentTok{// \textasciitilde{}36 ms @50MHz (reset del ILI9341)}
    \DataTypeTok{parameter} \DataTypeTok{integer}\NormalTok{ NPIX       }\OperatorTok{=} \DecValTok{76800}        \CommentTok{// 240 x 320}
\OperatorTok{)(}
    \DataTypeTok{input}  \DataTypeTok{wire}\NormalTok{       clk}\OperatorTok{,}
    \DataTypeTok{input}  \DataTypeTok{wire}\NormalTok{       rst\_n}\OperatorTok{,}          \CommentTok{// reset asincrono activo{-}bajo (ASIC: obligatorio)}
    \CommentTok{// {-}{-}{-}{-} stream de pixeles desde el filtro (upstream) {-}{-}{-}{-}}
    \DataTypeTok{input}  \DataTypeTok{wire} \OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{7}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{]}\NormalTok{ pix\_gray}\OperatorTok{,}       \CommentTok{// pixel actual (gris); debe mantenerse hasta pix\_next}
    \DataTypeTok{output} \DataTypeTok{reg}\NormalTok{        pix\_next}\OperatorTok{,}       \CommentTok{// pulso 1 ciclo: consumi un pixel, dame el siguiente}
    \DataTypeTok{output} \DataTypeTok{reg}\NormalTok{        frame\_start}\OperatorTok{,}    \CommentTok{// pulso: empieza un cuadro (upstream resetea su direccion)}
    \DataTypeTok{output} \DataTypeTok{wire}\NormalTok{       init\_done}\OperatorTok{,}      \CommentTok{// 1 = ILI9341 ya inicializado}
    \CommentTok{// {-}{-}{-}{-} pines del PMOD TFTLCD (SPI) {-}{-}{-}{-}}
    \DataTypeTok{output} \DataTypeTok{reg}\NormalTok{        tft\_sck}\OperatorTok{,}
    \DataTypeTok{output} \DataTypeTok{reg}\NormalTok{        tft\_mosi}\OperatorTok{,}
    \DataTypeTok{output} \DataTypeTok{reg}\NormalTok{        tft\_cs}\OperatorTok{,}
    \DataTypeTok{output} \DataTypeTok{reg}\NormalTok{        tft\_dc}
\OperatorTok{);}
    \CommentTok{// ============ shifter SPI (modo 0, MSB primero) ============}
    \DataTypeTok{reg}\NormalTok{        spi\_start}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ spi\_dcbit}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ spi\_done}\OperatorTok{;}
    \DataTypeTok{reg}  \OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{7}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{]}\NormalTok{ spi\_byte}\OperatorTok{;}
    \DataTypeTok{localparam}\NormalTok{ S\_IDLE}\OperatorTok{=}\BaseNTok{2\textquotesingle{}d0}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ S\_LO}\OperatorTok{=}\BaseNTok{2\textquotesingle{}d1}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ S\_HI}\OperatorTok{=}\BaseNTok{2\textquotesingle{}d2}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ S\_END}\OperatorTok{=}\BaseNTok{2\textquotesingle{}d3}\OperatorTok{;}
    \DataTypeTok{reg} \OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{1}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{]}\NormalTok{ sst}\OperatorTok{;}
    \DataTypeTok{reg} \OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{2}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{]}\NormalTok{ sbit}\OperatorTok{;}
    \DataTypeTok{reg} \OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{7}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{]}\NormalTok{ sbuf}\OperatorTok{;}
    \KeywordTok{always} \OperatorTok{@(}\KeywordTok{posedge}\NormalTok{ clk }\DataTypeTok{or} \KeywordTok{negedge}\NormalTok{ rst\_n}\OperatorTok{)} \KeywordTok{begin}
        \KeywordTok{if} \OperatorTok{(!}\NormalTok{rst\_n}\OperatorTok{)} \KeywordTok{begin}
\NormalTok{            sst}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\NormalTok{S\_IDLE}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ sbit}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\BaseNTok{3\textquotesingle{}d0}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ sbuf}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\BaseNTok{8\textquotesingle{}d0}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ spi\_done}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b0}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{            tft\_sck}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b0}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ tft\_mosi}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b0}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ tft\_cs}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b1}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ tft\_dc}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b1}\OperatorTok{;}
        \KeywordTok{end} \KeywordTok{else} \KeywordTok{begin}
\NormalTok{            spi\_done }\OperatorTok{\textless{}=} \BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b0}\OperatorTok{;}
            \KeywordTok{case} \OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{sst}\OperatorTok{)}
                \DecValTok{S\_IDLE:} \KeywordTok{if} \OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{spi\_start}\OperatorTok{)} \KeywordTok{begin}\NormalTok{ tft\_cs}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b0}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ tft\_dc}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\NormalTok{spi\_dcbit}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ sbuf}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\NormalTok{spi\_byte}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{                    sbit}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\BaseNTok{3\textquotesingle{}d0}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ tft\_sck}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b0}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ sst}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\NormalTok{S\_LO}\OperatorTok{;} \KeywordTok{end}
                \DecValTok{S\_LO:}  \KeywordTok{begin}\NormalTok{ tft\_sck}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b0}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ tft\_mosi}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\NormalTok{sbuf}\OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{7}\OperatorTok{];}\NormalTok{ sst}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\NormalTok{S\_HI}\OperatorTok{;} \KeywordTok{end}
                \DecValTok{S\_HI:}  \KeywordTok{begin}\NormalTok{ tft\_sck}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b1}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ sbuf}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=\{}\NormalTok{sbuf}\OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{6}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{],}\BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b0}\OperatorTok{\};}
                             \KeywordTok{if} \OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{sbit}\OperatorTok{==}\BaseNTok{3\textquotesingle{}d7}\OperatorTok{)}\NormalTok{ sst}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\NormalTok{S\_END}\OperatorTok{;} \KeywordTok{else} \KeywordTok{begin}\NormalTok{ sbit}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\NormalTok{sbit}\OperatorTok{+}\BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b1}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{                                 sst}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\NormalTok{S\_LO}\OperatorTok{;} \KeywordTok{end} \KeywordTok{end}
                \DecValTok{S\_END:} \KeywordTok{begin}\NormalTok{ tft\_sck}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b0}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ spi\_done}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b1}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ sst}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\NormalTok{S\_IDLE}\OperatorTok{;} \KeywordTok{end}
            \KeywordTok{endcase}
        \KeywordTok{end}
    \KeywordTok{end}

    \CommentTok{// ============ ROM de comandos (INIT + FRAME) ============}
    \DataTypeTok{localparam}\NormalTok{ T\_CMD}\OperatorTok{=}\BaseNTok{2\textquotesingle{}d0}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ T\_DAT}\OperatorTok{=}\BaseNTok{2\textquotesingle{}d1}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ T\_DLY}\OperatorTok{=}\BaseNTok{2\textquotesingle{}d2}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ T\_END}\OperatorTok{=}\BaseNTok{2\textquotesingle{}d3}\OperatorTok{;}
    \DataTypeTok{localparam}\NormalTok{ M\_BOOT}\OperatorTok{=}\BaseNTok{2\textquotesingle{}d0}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ M\_INIT}\OperatorTok{=}\BaseNTok{2\textquotesingle{}d1}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ M\_FRAME}\OperatorTok{=}\BaseNTok{2\textquotesingle{}d2}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ M\_FILL}\OperatorTok{=}\BaseNTok{2\textquotesingle{}d3}\OperatorTok{;}
    \DataTypeTok{reg} \OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{1}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{]}\NormalTok{ dmode}\OperatorTok{;}
    \DataTypeTok{reg} \OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{4}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{]}\NormalTok{ ip}\OperatorTok{;}
    \DataTypeTok{reg} \OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{1}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{]}\NormalTok{ rt}\OperatorTok{;} \DataTypeTok{reg} \OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{7}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{]}\NormalTok{ rb}\OperatorTok{;}
    \KeywordTok{always} \OperatorTok{@(}\NormalTok{*}\OperatorTok{)} \KeywordTok{begin}
\NormalTok{        rt}\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{T\_END}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ rb}\OperatorTok{=}\BaseNTok{8\textquotesingle{}h00}\OperatorTok{;}
        \KeywordTok{if} \OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{dmode}\OperatorTok{==}\NormalTok{M\_INIT}\OperatorTok{)} \KeywordTok{case} \OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{ip}\OperatorTok{)}
            \BaseNTok{5\textquotesingle{}d0}\OperatorTok{:} \KeywordTok{begin}\NormalTok{ rt}\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{T\_CMD}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ rb}\OperatorTok{=}\BaseNTok{8\textquotesingle{}h01}\OperatorTok{;} \KeywordTok{end}   \CommentTok{// SW reset}
            \BaseNTok{5\textquotesingle{}d1}\OperatorTok{:} \KeywordTok{begin}\NormalTok{ rt}\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{T\_DLY}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ rb}\OperatorTok{=}\BaseNTok{8\textquotesingle{}h00}\OperatorTok{;} \KeywordTok{end}
            \BaseNTok{5\textquotesingle{}d2}\OperatorTok{:} \KeywordTok{begin}\NormalTok{ rt}\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{T\_CMD}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ rb}\OperatorTok{=}\BaseNTok{8\textquotesingle{}h11}\OperatorTok{;} \KeywordTok{end}   \CommentTok{// sleep out}
            \BaseNTok{5\textquotesingle{}d3}\OperatorTok{:} \KeywordTok{begin}\NormalTok{ rt}\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{T\_DLY}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ rb}\OperatorTok{=}\BaseNTok{8\textquotesingle{}h00}\OperatorTok{;} \KeywordTok{end}
            \BaseNTok{5\textquotesingle{}d4}\OperatorTok{:} \KeywordTok{begin}\NormalTok{ rt}\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{T\_CMD}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ rb}\OperatorTok{=}\BaseNTok{8\textquotesingle{}h3A}\OperatorTok{;} \KeywordTok{end}   \CommentTok{// pixel format}
            \BaseNTok{5\textquotesingle{}d5}\OperatorTok{:} \KeywordTok{begin}\NormalTok{ rt}\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{T\_DAT}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ rb}\OperatorTok{=}\BaseNTok{8\textquotesingle{}h55}\OperatorTok{;} \KeywordTok{end}   \CommentTok{//   RGB565}
            \BaseNTok{5\textquotesingle{}d6}\OperatorTok{:} \KeywordTok{begin}\NormalTok{ rt}\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{T\_CMD}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ rb}\OperatorTok{=}\BaseNTok{8\textquotesingle{}h36}\OperatorTok{;} \KeywordTok{end}   \CommentTok{// MADCTL}
            \BaseNTok{5\textquotesingle{}d7}\OperatorTok{:} \KeywordTok{begin}\NormalTok{ rt}\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{T\_DAT}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ rb}\OperatorTok{=}\BaseNTok{8\textquotesingle{}h48}\OperatorTok{;} \KeywordTok{end}
            \BaseNTok{5\textquotesingle{}d8}\OperatorTok{:} \KeywordTok{begin}\NormalTok{ rt}\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{T\_CMD}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ rb}\OperatorTok{=}\BaseNTok{8\textquotesingle{}h29}\OperatorTok{;} \KeywordTok{end}   \CommentTok{// display ON}
            \KeywordTok{default}\OperatorTok{:} \KeywordTok{begin}\NormalTok{ rt}\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{T\_END}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ rb}\OperatorTok{=}\BaseNTok{8\textquotesingle{}h00}\OperatorTok{;} \KeywordTok{end}
        \KeywordTok{endcase}
        \KeywordTok{else} \KeywordTok{case} \OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{ip}\OperatorTok{)}                            \CommentTok{// M\_FRAME: ventana + RAMWR}
            \BaseNTok{5\textquotesingle{}d0}\OperatorTok{:}  \KeywordTok{begin}\NormalTok{ rt}\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{T\_CMD}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ rb}\OperatorTok{=}\BaseNTok{8\textquotesingle{}h2A}\OperatorTok{;} \KeywordTok{end}   \CommentTok{// CASET}
            \BaseNTok{5\textquotesingle{}d1}\OperatorTok{:}  \KeywordTok{begin}\NormalTok{ rt}\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{T\_DAT}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ rb}\OperatorTok{=}\BaseNTok{8\textquotesingle{}h00}\OperatorTok{;} \KeywordTok{end}
            \BaseNTok{5\textquotesingle{}d2}\OperatorTok{:}  \KeywordTok{begin}\NormalTok{ rt}\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{T\_DAT}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ rb}\OperatorTok{=}\BaseNTok{8\textquotesingle{}h00}\OperatorTok{;} \KeywordTok{end}
            \BaseNTok{5\textquotesingle{}d3}\OperatorTok{:}  \KeywordTok{begin}\NormalTok{ rt}\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{T\_DAT}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ rb}\OperatorTok{=}\BaseNTok{8\textquotesingle{}h00}\OperatorTok{;} \KeywordTok{end}
            \BaseNTok{5\textquotesingle{}d4}\OperatorTok{:}  \KeywordTok{begin}\NormalTok{ rt}\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{T\_DAT}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ rb}\OperatorTok{=}\BaseNTok{8\textquotesingle{}hEF}\OperatorTok{;} \KeywordTok{end}   \CommentTok{//   239}
            \BaseNTok{5\textquotesingle{}d5}\OperatorTok{:}  \KeywordTok{begin}\NormalTok{ rt}\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{T\_CMD}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ rb}\OperatorTok{=}\BaseNTok{8\textquotesingle{}h2B}\OperatorTok{;} \KeywordTok{end}   \CommentTok{// RASET}
            \BaseNTok{5\textquotesingle{}d6}\OperatorTok{:}  \KeywordTok{begin}\NormalTok{ rt}\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{T\_DAT}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ rb}\OperatorTok{=}\BaseNTok{8\textquotesingle{}h00}\OperatorTok{;} \KeywordTok{end}
            \BaseNTok{5\textquotesingle{}d7}\OperatorTok{:}  \KeywordTok{begin}\NormalTok{ rt}\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{T\_DAT}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ rb}\OperatorTok{=}\BaseNTok{8\textquotesingle{}h00}\OperatorTok{;} \KeywordTok{end}
            \BaseNTok{5\textquotesingle{}d8}\OperatorTok{:}  \KeywordTok{begin}\NormalTok{ rt}\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{T\_DAT}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ rb}\OperatorTok{=}\BaseNTok{8\textquotesingle{}h01}\OperatorTok{;} \KeywordTok{end}
            \BaseNTok{5\textquotesingle{}d9}\OperatorTok{:}  \KeywordTok{begin}\NormalTok{ rt}\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{T\_DAT}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ rb}\OperatorTok{=}\BaseNTok{8\textquotesingle{}h3F}\OperatorTok{;} \KeywordTok{end}   \CommentTok{//   319}
            \BaseNTok{5\textquotesingle{}d10}\OperatorTok{:} \KeywordTok{begin}\NormalTok{ rt}\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{T\_CMD}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ rb}\OperatorTok{=}\BaseNTok{8\textquotesingle{}h2C}\OperatorTok{;} \KeywordTok{end}   \CommentTok{// RAMWR}
            \KeywordTok{default}\OperatorTok{:} \KeywordTok{begin}\NormalTok{ rt}\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{T\_END}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ rb}\OperatorTok{=}\BaseNTok{8\textquotesingle{}h00}\OperatorTok{;} \KeywordTok{end}
        \KeywordTok{endcase}
    \KeywordTok{end}

    \CommentTok{// ============ FSM de display ============}
    \DataTypeTok{reg} \OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{20}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{]}\NormalTok{ dcnt}\OperatorTok{;}
    \DataTypeTok{reg} \OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{16}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{]}\NormalTok{ px}\OperatorTok{;}
    \DataTypeTok{reg}\NormalTok{        pxhi}\OperatorTok{;}
    \DataTypeTok{reg}\NormalTok{        sending}\OperatorTok{;}
    \DataTypeTok{reg} \OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{15}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{]}\NormalTok{ pcolor\_l}\OperatorTok{;}
    \DataTypeTok{wire} \OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{15}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{]}\NormalTok{ pcolor\_w }\OperatorTok{=} \OperatorTok{\{}\NormalTok{pix\_gray}\OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{7}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{3}\OperatorTok{],}\NormalTok{ pix\_gray}\OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{7}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{2}\OperatorTok{],}\NormalTok{ pix\_gray}\OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{7}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{3}\OperatorTok{]\};} \CommentTok{// gris {-}\textgreater{} RGB565}

    \KeywordTok{assign}\NormalTok{ init\_done }\OperatorTok{=} \OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{dmode}\OperatorTok{==}\NormalTok{M\_FRAME}\OperatorTok{)} \OperatorTok{||} \OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{dmode}\OperatorTok{==}\NormalTok{M\_FILL}\OperatorTok{);}

    \KeywordTok{always} \OperatorTok{@(}\KeywordTok{posedge}\NormalTok{ clk }\DataTypeTok{or} \KeywordTok{negedge}\NormalTok{ rst\_n}\OperatorTok{)} \KeywordTok{begin}
        \KeywordTok{if} \OperatorTok{(!}\NormalTok{rst\_n}\OperatorTok{)} \KeywordTok{begin}
\NormalTok{            dmode}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\NormalTok{M\_BOOT}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ ip}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\BaseNTok{5\textquotesingle{}d0}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ dcnt}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\BaseNTok{21\textquotesingle{}d0}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ px}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\BaseNTok{17\textquotesingle{}d0}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ pxhi}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b0}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ sending}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b0}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{            spi\_start}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b0}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ spi\_byte}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\BaseNTok{8\textquotesingle{}d0}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ spi\_dcbit}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b1}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ pix\_next}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b0}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{                frame\_start}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b0}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ pcolor\_l}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\BaseNTok{16\textquotesingle{}d0}\OperatorTok{;}
        \KeywordTok{end} \KeywordTok{else} \KeywordTok{begin}
\NormalTok{            spi\_start   }\OperatorTok{\textless{}=} \BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b0}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{            pix\_next    }\OperatorTok{\textless{}=} \BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b0}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{            frame\_start }\OperatorTok{\textless{}=} \BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b0}\OperatorTok{;}
            \KeywordTok{case} \OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{dmode}\OperatorTok{)}
            \DecValTok{M\_BOOT:} \KeywordTok{begin}
\NormalTok{                dcnt }\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\NormalTok{ dcnt }\OperatorTok{+} \BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b1}\OperatorTok{;}
                \KeywordTok{if} \OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{dcnt }\OperatorTok{==}\NormalTok{ BOOT\_DELAY}\OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{20}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{])} \KeywordTok{begin}\NormalTok{ dcnt}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\BaseNTok{21\textquotesingle{}d0}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ dmode}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\NormalTok{M\_INIT}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ ip}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\BaseNTok{5\textquotesingle{}d0}\OperatorTok{;} \KeywordTok{end}
            \KeywordTok{end}
            \DecValTok{M\_INIT:} \KeywordTok{begin}
                \KeywordTok{if} \OperatorTok{(!}\NormalTok{sending}\OperatorTok{)} \KeywordTok{begin}
                    \KeywordTok{case} \OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{rt}\OperatorTok{)}
                        \DecValTok{T\_CMD,T\_DAT:} \KeywordTok{begin}\NormalTok{ spi\_byte}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\NormalTok{rb}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ spi\_dcbit}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=(}\NormalTok{rt}\OperatorTok{==}\NormalTok{T\_DAT}\OperatorTok{);}
\NormalTok{                            spi\_start}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b1}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ sending}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b1}\OperatorTok{;} \KeywordTok{end}
                        \DecValTok{T\_DLY:} \KeywordTok{if} \OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{dcnt}\OperatorTok{==}\NormalTok{BOOT\_DELAY}\OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{20}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{])} \KeywordTok{begin}\NormalTok{ dcnt}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\BaseNTok{21\textquotesingle{}d0}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ ip}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\NormalTok{ip}\OperatorTok{+}\BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b1}\OperatorTok{;}
                            \KeywordTok{end} \KeywordTok{else}\NormalTok{ dcnt}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\NormalTok{dcnt}\OperatorTok{+}\BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b1}\OperatorTok{;}
                        \KeywordTok{default}\OperatorTok{:} \KeywordTok{begin}\NormalTok{ dmode}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\NormalTok{M\_FRAME}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ ip}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\BaseNTok{5\textquotesingle{}d0}\OperatorTok{;} \KeywordTok{end}
                    \KeywordTok{endcase}
                \KeywordTok{end} \KeywordTok{else} \KeywordTok{if} \OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{spi\_done}\OperatorTok{)} \KeywordTok{begin}\NormalTok{ sending}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b0}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ ip}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\NormalTok{ip}\OperatorTok{+}\BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b1}\OperatorTok{;} \KeywordTok{end}
            \KeywordTok{end}
            \DecValTok{M\_FRAME:} \KeywordTok{begin}
                \KeywordTok{if} \OperatorTok{(!}\NormalTok{sending}\OperatorTok{)} \KeywordTok{begin}
                    \KeywordTok{case} \OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{rt}\OperatorTok{)}
                        \DecValTok{T\_CMD,T\_DAT:} \KeywordTok{begin}\NormalTok{ spi\_byte}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\NormalTok{rb}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ spi\_dcbit}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=(}\NormalTok{rt}\OperatorTok{==}\NormalTok{T\_DAT}\OperatorTok{);}
\NormalTok{                            spi\_start}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b1}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ sending}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b1}\OperatorTok{;} \KeywordTok{end}
                        \KeywordTok{default}\OperatorTok{:} \KeywordTok{begin}\NormalTok{ dmode}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\NormalTok{M\_FILL}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ px}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\BaseNTok{17\textquotesingle{}d0}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ pxhi}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b0}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{                            frame\_start}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b1}\OperatorTok{;} \KeywordTok{end}
                    \KeywordTok{endcase}
                \KeywordTok{end} \KeywordTok{else} \KeywordTok{if} \OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{spi\_done}\OperatorTok{)} \KeywordTok{begin}\NormalTok{ sending}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b0}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ ip}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\NormalTok{ip}\OperatorTok{+}\BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b1}\OperatorTok{;} \KeywordTok{end}
            \KeywordTok{end}
            \DecValTok{M\_FILL:} \KeywordTok{begin}
                \KeywordTok{if} \OperatorTok{(!}\NormalTok{sending}\OperatorTok{)} \KeywordTok{begin}

\NormalTok{                    spi\_dcbit}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b1}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ spi\_start}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b1}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ sending}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b1}\OperatorTok{;}

\NormalTok{                    sending}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b0}\OperatorTok{;}
                    \KeywordTok{if} \OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{pxhi}\OperatorTok{)} \KeywordTok{begin}

\NormalTok{                        pxhi}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b0}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ pix\_next}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b1}\OperatorTok{;}
                        \KeywordTok{if} \OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{px}\OperatorTok{==}\NormalTok{NPIX}\OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{16}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{]{-}}\BaseNTok{17\textquotesingle{}d1}\OperatorTok{)} \KeywordTok{begin}\NormalTok{ px}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\BaseNTok{17\textquotesingle{}d0}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ dmode}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\NormalTok{M\_FRAME}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ ip}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\BaseNTok{5\textquotesingle{}d0}\OperatorTok{;} \KeywordTok{end}

\subsection{G.8 Canny 1-streaming completo
(§4.3.8)}\label{g.8-canny-1-streaming-completo-4.3.8}

Es el circuito \texttt{canny1\_completo}, el \#2 de la §5.3: 2,90 mm² en
sky130. \texttt{canny1\_completo.v} conecta el front-end de cámara, el
Canny de un salto de la G.2, el framebuffer de 60×80 bits y el
controlador de pantalla. Los bloques de interfaz son idénticos a los de
la G.7 y no se repiten.

Carpeta: \texttt{Verilog\_Repo/completos/canny1\_completo/}.

\subsubsection{\texorpdfstring{\texttt{canny1\_completo.v}}{canny1\_completo.v}}\label{canny1_completo.v}

\CommentTok{//   camara OV7670 {-}{-}\textgreater{} [cam\_frontend\_top: SCCB + captura + CDC + RGB565{-}\textgreater{}gris]}
\CommentTok{// {-}{-}\textgreater{} [canny1\_top: Gaussian 3x3 {-}\textgreater{} Sobel 3x3 {-}\textgreater{} doble umbral {-}\textgreater{} histeresis 1{-}salto]}
\CommentTok{// {-}{-}\textgreater{} [framebuffer 60x80, 1 bit/pixel] (puente stream{-}\textgreater{}pantalla; bordes binarios)}

    \CommentTok{// ===== 1) FRONT{-}}\RegionMarkerTok{END}\CommentTok{: camara {-}\textgreater{} stream de gris (dominio clk) =====}
    \DataTypeTok{wire} \OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{7}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{]}\NormalTok{ gray}\OperatorTok{;} \DataTypeTok{wire}\NormalTok{ gray\_valid}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ fe\_frame\_start}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ fe\_line\_start}\OperatorTok{;}

\NormalTok{        .cam\_xclk}\OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{cam\_xclk}\OperatorTok{),}\NormalTok{ .cam\_sioc}\OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{cam\_sioc}\OperatorTok{),}\NormalTok{ .cam\_siod\_o}\OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{cam\_siod\_o}\OperatorTok{),}

    \DataTypeTok{wire}\NormalTok{ can\_v}\OperatorTok{;} \DataTypeTok{wire} \OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{7}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{]}\NormalTok{ can\_p}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{    canny1\_top u\_can }\OperatorTok{(}
\NormalTok{        .clk}\OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{clk}\OperatorTok{),}\NormalTok{ .reset}\OperatorTok{(\textasciitilde{}}\NormalTok{rst\_n}\OperatorTok{),}
\NormalTok{        .in\_valid}\OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{gray\_valid}\OperatorTok{),}\NormalTok{ .in\_pix}\OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{gray}\OperatorTok{),}\NormalTok{ .thr\_hi}\OperatorTok{(}\BaseNTok{8\textquotesingle{}d90}\OperatorTok{),}\NormalTok{ .thr\_lo}\OperatorTok{(}\BaseNTok{8\textquotesingle{}d40}\OperatorTok{),}

    \KeywordTok{always} \OperatorTok{@(}\KeywordTok{posedge}\NormalTok{ clk }\DataTypeTok{or} \KeywordTok{negedge}\NormalTok{ rst\_n}\OperatorTok{)} \KeywordTok{begin}

        \KeywordTok{else} \KeywordTok{if} \OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{can\_v}\OperatorTok{)} \KeywordTok{begin}

\NormalTok{            fb}\OperatorTok{[}\NormalTok{wadr}\OperatorTok{]} \OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\NormalTok{ can\_p}\OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{7}\OperatorTok{];}
\NormalTok{            wadr }\OperatorTok{\textless{}=} \OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{wadr }\OperatorTok{==} \BaseNTok{13\textquotesingle{}d4799}\OperatorTok{)} \OperatorTok{?} \BaseNTok{13\textquotesingle{}d0} \OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ wadr }\OperatorTok{+} \BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b1}\OperatorTok{;}
        \KeywordTok{end}
    \KeywordTok{end}

    \CommentTok{//   60x80) =====}

    \DataTypeTok{reg} \OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{7}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{]}\NormalTok{ xcol}\OperatorTok{;} \DataTypeTok{reg} \OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{8}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{]}\NormalTok{ ycol}\OperatorTok{;}
    \KeywordTok{always} \OperatorTok{@(}\KeywordTok{posedge}\NormalTok{ clk }\DataTypeTok{or} \KeywordTok{negedge}\NormalTok{ rst\_n}\OperatorTok{)} \KeywordTok{begin}
        \KeywordTok{if} \OperatorTok{(!}\NormalTok{rst\_n}\OperatorTok{)} \KeywordTok{begin}\NormalTok{ xcol }\OperatorTok{\textless{}=} \BaseNTok{8\textquotesingle{}d0}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ ycol }\OperatorTok{\textless{}=} \BaseNTok{9\textquotesingle{}d0}\OperatorTok{;} \KeywordTok{end}
        \KeywordTok{else} \KeywordTok{if} \OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{lcd\_fs}\OperatorTok{)} \KeywordTok{begin}\NormalTok{ xcol }\OperatorTok{\textless{}=} \BaseNTok{8\textquotesingle{}d0}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ ycol }\OperatorTok{\textless{}=} \BaseNTok{9\textquotesingle{}d0}\OperatorTok{;} \KeywordTok{end}
        \KeywordTok{else} \KeywordTok{if} \OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{lcd\_next}\OperatorTok{)} \KeywordTok{begin}
            \KeywordTok{if} \OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{xcol }\OperatorTok{==} \BaseNTok{8\textquotesingle{}d239}\OperatorTok{)} \KeywordTok{begin}\NormalTok{ xcol }\OperatorTok{\textless{}=} \BaseNTok{8\textquotesingle{}d0}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ ycol }\OperatorTok{\textless{}=} \OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{ycol}\OperatorTok{==}\BaseNTok{9\textquotesingle{}d319}\OperatorTok{)?}\BaseNTok{9\textquotesingle{}d0}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ycol}\OperatorTok{+}\BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b1}\OperatorTok{;} \KeywordTok{end}
            \KeywordTok{else}\NormalTok{ xcol }\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\NormalTok{ xcol }\OperatorTok{+} \BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b1}\OperatorTok{;}
        \KeywordTok{end}
    \KeywordTok{end}
    \DataTypeTok{wire} \OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{6}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{]}\NormalTok{ fx }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ xcol}\OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{7}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{2}\OperatorTok{];}
    \DataTypeTok{wire} \OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{6}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{]}\NormalTok{ fy }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ ycol}\OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{8}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{2}\OperatorTok{];}

\NormalTok{        .clk}\OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{clk}\OperatorTok{),}\NormalTok{ .rst\_n}\OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{rst\_n}\OperatorTok{),}

\NormalTok{        .tft\_sck}\OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{tft\_sck}\OperatorTok{),}\NormalTok{ .tft\_mosi}\OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{tft\_mosi}\OperatorTok{),}\NormalTok{ .tft\_cs}\OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{tft\_cs}\OperatorTok{),}\NormalTok{ .tft\_dc}\OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{tft\_dc}\OperatorTok{));}

\subsection{G.9 Visión Sobel (§4.3.9)}\label{g.9-visiuxf3n-sobel-4.3.9}

Es el circuito \texttt{vision\_top} de la §5.2: 1,75 mm² en sky130. Todo
el sistema está en un fichero, portado de
\texttt{cam\_sobel\_display.v}, el diseño que funcionaba en la FPGA; la
cabecera enumera los tres cambios que exigió el silicio.

Carpeta: \texttt{Verilog\_Repo/vision\_top/}.

\subsubsection{\texorpdfstring{\texttt{vision\_top.v}}{vision\_top.v}}\label{vision_top.v}

\begin{Shaded}
\begin{Highlighting}[]
\CommentTok{// vision\_top.v — EL CHIP QUE VE Y MUESTRA, integrado para ASIC sky130 (fase 9, "todo}
\CommentTok{//   en el ASIC").}
\CommentTok{// camara OV7670 {-}\textgreater{} SCCB config {-}\textgreater{} submuestreo 60x80 {-}\textgreater{} SOBEL 3x3 {-}\textgreater{} framebuffer {-}\textgreater{}}
\CommentTok{//   display ILI9341.}
\CommentTok{//   Portado del diseno FISICO verificado en FPGA (cam\_sobel\_display.v). 3 cambios ASIC:}
\CommentTok{// (1) RESET EXPLICITO (rst\_n) en los FSM de control {-}\textgreater{} los FF arrancan aleatorios en}
\CommentTok{//   silicio.}
\CommentTok{// (2) cam\_sda open{-}drain (inout, 1\textquotesingle{}bz) partido en cam\_sda\_o/cam\_sda\_oe {-}\textgreater{} el tri{-}state}
\CommentTok{//   va al pad ring.}
\CommentTok{//     (3) sin SB\_RGBA\_DRV (LEDs, primitiva iCE40).}
\CommentTok{// DUAL{-}CLOCK: SCCB+display en \textquotesingle{}clk\textquotesingle{}; captura+Sobel+escritura del framebuffer en}
\CommentTok{//   \textquotesingle{}cam\_pclk\textquotesingle{}.}
\CommentTok{// El framebuffer (60x80 x 8b = 38 400 FF) NO se resetea (se llena antes de leerse) —}
\CommentTok{//   como el transitivo.}
\OtherTok{\textasciigrave{}default\_nettype none}
\KeywordTok{module}\NormalTok{ vision\_top }\OperatorTok{(}
    \DataTypeTok{input}  \DataTypeTok{wire}\NormalTok{       clk}\OperatorTok{,}
    \DataTypeTok{input}  \DataTypeTok{wire}\NormalTok{       rst\_n}\OperatorTok{,}
    \CommentTok{// {-}{-}{-}{-} camara OV7670 {-}{-}{-}{-}}
    \DataTypeTok{output} \DataTypeTok{wire}\NormalTok{       cam\_xclk}\OperatorTok{,}
    \DataTypeTok{output} \DataTypeTok{reg}\NormalTok{        cam\_scl}\OperatorTok{,}
    \DataTypeTok{output} \DataTypeTok{wire}\NormalTok{       cam\_sda\_o}\OperatorTok{,}     \CommentTok{// open{-}drain: dato (siempre 0 cuando activo)}
    \DataTypeTok{output} \DataTypeTok{wire}\NormalTok{       cam\_sda\_oe}\OperatorTok{,}    \CommentTok{// open{-}drain: enable {-}\textgreater{} el pad hace el tri{-}state}
    \DataTypeTok{input}  \DataTypeTok{wire}\NormalTok{       cam\_pclk}\OperatorTok{,}
    \DataTypeTok{input}  \DataTypeTok{wire}\NormalTok{       cam\_href}\OperatorTok{,}
    \DataTypeTok{input}  \DataTypeTok{wire} \OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{7}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{]}\NormalTok{ cam\_d}\OperatorTok{,}
    \CommentTok{// {-}{-}{-}{-} display PMOD TFTLCD {-}{-}{-}{-}}
    \DataTypeTok{output} \DataTypeTok{wire}\NormalTok{       tft\_sck}\OperatorTok{,}
    \DataTypeTok{output} \DataTypeTok{wire}\NormalTok{       tft\_mosi}\OperatorTok{,}
    \DataTypeTok{output} \DataTypeTok{wire}\NormalTok{       tft\_cs}\OperatorTok{,}
    \DataTypeTok{output} \DataTypeTok{wire}\NormalTok{       tft\_dc}\OperatorTok{,}
    \CommentTok{// {-}{-}{-}{-} estado {-}{-}{-}{-}}
    \DataTypeTok{output} \DataTypeTok{reg}\NormalTok{        cfg\_done}
\OperatorTok{);}
    \KeywordTok{assign}\NormalTok{ cam\_xclk }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ clk}\OperatorTok{;}

    \CommentTok{// ==================== SCCB config (dominio clk) ====================}
    \DataTypeTok{reg}\NormalTok{ sda\_oe}\OperatorTok{;}
    \KeywordTok{assign}\NormalTok{ cam\_sda\_o  }\OperatorTok{=} \BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b0}\OperatorTok{;}
    \KeywordTok{assign}\NormalTok{ cam\_sda\_oe }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ sda\_oe}\OperatorTok{;}

    \DataTypeTok{reg} \OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{5}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{]}\NormalTok{ tdiv}\OperatorTok{;}
    \DataTypeTok{wire}\NormalTok{ tick }\OperatorTok{=} \OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{tdiv }\OperatorTok{==} \BaseNTok{6\textquotesingle{}d29}\OperatorTok{);}
    \KeywordTok{always} \OperatorTok{@(}\KeywordTok{posedge}\NormalTok{ clk }\DataTypeTok{or} \KeywordTok{negedge}\NormalTok{ rst\_n}\OperatorTok{)}
        \KeywordTok{if} \OperatorTok{(!}\NormalTok{rst\_n}\OperatorTok{)}\NormalTok{ tdiv }\OperatorTok{\textless{}=} \BaseNTok{6\textquotesingle{}d0}\OperatorTok{;} \KeywordTok{else}\NormalTok{ tdiv }\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\NormalTok{ tick }\OperatorTok{?} \BaseNTok{6\textquotesingle{}d0} \OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ tdiv }\OperatorTok{+} \BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b1}\OperatorTok{;}

    \DataTypeTok{reg} \OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{4}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{]}\NormalTok{ idx}\OperatorTok{;}
    \DataTypeTok{reg} \OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{15}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{]}\NormalTok{ rom}\OperatorTok{;}
    \KeywordTok{always} \OperatorTok{@(}\NormalTok{*}\OperatorTok{)} \KeywordTok{case} \OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{idx}\OperatorTok{)}
        \BaseNTok{5\textquotesingle{}d0}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{  rom }\OperatorTok{=} \BaseNTok{16\textquotesingle{}h12\_00}\OperatorTok{;}
        \BaseNTok{5\textquotesingle{}d1}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{  rom }\OperatorTok{=} \BaseNTok{16\textquotesingle{}h13\_E7}\OperatorTok{;}
        \BaseNTok{5\textquotesingle{}d2}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{  rom }\OperatorTok{=} \BaseNTok{16\textquotesingle{}h09\_18}\OperatorTok{;}
        \KeywordTok{default}\OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ rom }\OperatorTok{=} \BaseNTok{16\textquotesingle{}hFF\_FF}\OperatorTok{;}
    \KeywordTok{endcase}
    \DataTypeTok{wire}\NormalTok{       tbl\_end  }\OperatorTok{=} \OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{rom }\OperatorTok{==} \BaseNTok{16\textquotesingle{}hFF\_FF}\OperatorTok{);}
    \DataTypeTok{wire} \OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{7}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{]}\NormalTok{ reg\_addr }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ rom}\OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{15}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{8}\OperatorTok{];}
    \DataTypeTok{wire} \OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{7}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{]}\NormalTok{ reg\_val  }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ rom}\OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{7}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{];}

    \DataTypeTok{localparam}\NormalTok{ C\_START}\OperatorTok{=}\BaseNTok{3\textquotesingle{}d0}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ C\_WR}\OperatorTok{=}\BaseNTok{3\textquotesingle{}d1}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ C\_STOP}\OperatorTok{=}\BaseNTok{3\textquotesingle{}d2}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ C\_DLY}\OperatorTok{=}\BaseNTok{3\textquotesingle{}d3}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ C\_NEXT}\OperatorTok{=}\BaseNTok{3\textquotesingle{}d4}\OperatorTok{;}
    \DataTypeTok{reg} \OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{2}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{]}\NormalTok{ cpc}\OperatorTok{;}
    \DataTypeTok{reg} \OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{1}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{]}\NormalTok{ cph}\OperatorTok{;}
    \DataTypeTok{reg} \OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{3}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{]}\NormalTok{ cbi}\OperatorTok{;}
    \DataTypeTok{reg} \OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{15}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{]}\NormalTok{ cdly}\OperatorTok{;}

\subsection{G.10 Visión Canny 1-streaming
(§4.3.10)}\label{g.10-visiuxf3n-canny-1-streaming-4.3.10}

Es el circuito \texttt{vision\_canny} de la §5.2: 2,04 mm² en sky130.
Todo el sistema está en un fichero, portado de
\texttt{cam\_canny2\_display.v}; la cabecera enumera los mismos tres
cambios que el de la G.9.

Carpeta: \texttt{Verilog\_Repo/vision\_canny/}.

\subsection{G.11 Visión Canny Framebuffer Transitivo
(§4.3.11)}\label{g.11-visiuxf3n-canny-framebuffer-transitivo-4.3.11}

Es el circuito \texttt{trans\_completo}, el \#3 de la §5.3: 9,61 mm² en
sky130. \texttt{trans\_completo.v} conecta la cadena y declara el
framebuffer de clases y el de bordes; \texttt{grad\_class\_top.v}
calcula la clase de cada píxel con el suavizado, el gradiente y el doble
umbral. El motor es el de la G.3, y los bloques de interfaz, los de la
G.7.

Carpeta: \texttt{Verilog\_Repo/completos/trans\_completo/}.

    \DataTypeTok{wire} \OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{1}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{]}\NormalTok{  cls }\OperatorTok{=} \OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{mag}\OperatorTok{\textgreater{}}\NormalTok{thr\_hi}\OperatorTok{)?}\BaseNTok{2\textquotesingle{}d2} \OperatorTok{:} \OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{mag}\OperatorTok{\textgreater{}}\NormalTok{thr\_lo}\OperatorTok{)?}\BaseNTok{2\textquotesingle{}d1} \OperatorTok{:} \BaseNTok{2\textquotesingle{}d0}\OperatorTok{;}   \CommentTok{// doble umbral}
    \KeywordTok{always} \OperatorTok{@(}\KeywordTok{posedge}\NormalTok{ clk}\OperatorTok{)} \KeywordTok{begin}
        \KeywordTok{if} \OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{reset}\OperatorTok{)} \KeywordTok{begin}\NormalTok{ out\_valid}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b0}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ class\_out}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\BaseNTok{2\textquotesingle{}d0}\OperatorTok{;} \KeywordTok{end}
        \KeywordTok{else} \KeywordTok{begin}\NormalTok{ out\_valid}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\NormalTok{vs}\OperatorTok{;}\NormalTok{ class\_out}\OperatorTok{\textless{}=}\NormalTok{cls}\OperatorTok{;} \KeywordTok{end}
    \KeywordTok{end}
\KeywordTok{endmodule}
\OtherTok{\textasciigrave{}default\_nettype wire}
\end{Highlighting}
\end{Shaded}

\subsection{G.12 Mini Sobel en Tiny Tapeout
(§4.3.12)}\label{g.12-mini-sobel-en-tiny-tapeout-4.3.12}

Es el proyecto \texttt{tt\_um\_sobel\_vic}, de 3×2 mosaicos.
\texttt{tt\_um\_sobel\_vic.v} adapta los pines de la lanzadera;
\texttt{sobel\_top.v} es el de la G.1 con una línea más ---pasa el
reinicio al generador de ventana--- y \texttt{linebuf3x3.v} es el de la
G.1 \textbf{con reinicio explícito} en todos sus registros, la versión
que el silicio necesita.

Carpeta: \texttt{tinytapeout/tt\_sobel/src/} del repositorio de la
tesis.

\subsubsection{\texorpdfstring{\texttt{tt\_um\_sobel\_vic.v}}{tt\_um\_sobel\_vic.v}}\label{tt_um_sobel_vic.v}

\begin{Shaded}
\begin{Highlighting}[]
\CommentTok{// tt\_um\_sobel\_vic.v — Sobel 3x3 de bordes (Victor, UNAL) envuelto para Tiny Tapeout.}
\CommentTok{// Interfaz TT (8 in + 8 out + 8 bidi + clk/rst\_n/ena). Umbral fijo (TT no alcanza para}
\CommentTok{//   8 pines mas).}
\CommentTok{// Pixel entra por ui\_in; in\_valid por uio\_in[0]; out\_pix por uo\_out; out\_valid por}
\CommentTok{//   uio\_out[1].}
\CommentTok{// Es el filtro mas chico de los tres: solo 2 line{-}buffers y sumadores, sin Gaussiano}
\CommentTok{//   ni CPU.}
\OtherTok{\textasciigrave{}default\_nettype none}
\KeywordTok{module}\NormalTok{ tt\_um\_sobel\_vic }\OperatorTok{(}
    \DataTypeTok{input}  \DataTypeTok{wire} \OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{7}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{]}\NormalTok{ ui\_in}\OperatorTok{,}    \CommentTok{// in\_pix[7:0]}
    \DataTypeTok{output} \DataTypeTok{wire} \OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{7}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{]}\NormalTok{ uo\_out}\OperatorTok{,}   \CommentTok{// out\_pix[7:0]}
    \DataTypeTok{input}  \DataTypeTok{wire} \OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{7}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{]}\NormalTok{ uio\_in}\OperatorTok{,}   \CommentTok{// uio\_in[0] = in\_valid}
    \DataTypeTok{output} \DataTypeTok{wire} \OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{7}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{]}\NormalTok{ uio\_out}\OperatorTok{,}  \CommentTok{// uio\_out[1] = out\_valid}
    \DataTypeTok{output} \DataTypeTok{wire} \OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{7}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{]}\NormalTok{ uio\_oe}\OperatorTok{,}   \CommentTok{// habilitacion bidi (1=salida)}
    \DataTypeTok{input}  \DataTypeTok{wire}\NormalTok{       ena}\OperatorTok{,}      \CommentTok{// 1 cuando el diseno esta activo}
    \DataTypeTok{input}  \DataTypeTok{wire}\NormalTok{       clk}\OperatorTok{,}
    \DataTypeTok{input}  \DataTypeTok{wire}\NormalTok{       rst\_n     }\CommentTok{// reset activo{-}bajo}
\OperatorTok{);}
    \DataTypeTok{wire}\NormalTok{ out\_valid}\OperatorTok{;}
    \DataTypeTok{localparam} \OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{7}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{]}\NormalTok{ THR }\OperatorTok{=} \BaseNTok{8\textquotesingle{}d90}\OperatorTok{;}   \CommentTok{// umbral de borde (fijo; el mismo del SoC en FPGA)}

\NormalTok{    sobel\_top u\_sobel }\OperatorTok{(}
\NormalTok{        .clk}\OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{clk}\OperatorTok{),}\NormalTok{ .reset}\OperatorTok{(\textasciitilde{}}\NormalTok{rst\_n}\OperatorTok{),}                  \CommentTok{// sobel\_top usa reset activo{-}alto}
\NormalTok{        .in\_valid}\OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{uio\_in}\OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{]),}\NormalTok{ .in\_pix}\OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{ui\_in}\OperatorTok{),}
\NormalTok{        .thr}\OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{THR}\OperatorTok{),}
\NormalTok{        .out\_valid}\OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{out\_valid}\OperatorTok{),}\NormalTok{ .out\_pix}\OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{uo\_out}\OperatorTok{));}

    \KeywordTok{assign}\NormalTok{ uio\_out }\OperatorTok{=} \OperatorTok{\{}\BaseNTok{6\textquotesingle{}b0}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ out\_valid}\OperatorTok{,} \BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b0}\OperatorTok{\};}       \CommentTok{// out\_valid en bit 1}
    \KeywordTok{assign}\NormalTok{ uio\_oe  }\OperatorTok{=} \BaseNTok{8\textquotesingle{}b0000\_0010}\OperatorTok{;}                  \CommentTok{// uio[1]=salida; resto entradas}
    \DataTypeTok{wire}\NormalTok{ \_unused }\OperatorTok{=} \OperatorTok{\&\{}\NormalTok{ena}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ uio\_in}\OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{7}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{1}\OperatorTok{],} \BaseNTok{1\textquotesingle{}b0}\OperatorTok{\};}       \CommentTok{// evita warnings de senales sin usar}
\KeywordTok{endmodule}
\OtherTok{\textasciigrave{}default\_nettype wire}
\end{Highlighting}

\subsubsection{\texorpdfstring{\texttt{sobel\_top.v}}{sobel\_top.v}}\label{sobel_top.v-1}

\begin{Shaded}
\begin{Highlighting}[]
\CommentTok{// sobel\_top.v — Sobel de bordes AUTOCONTENIDO para ASIC (sky130), datapath de Victor.}

\CommentTok{// Misma matematica que el SoC femto (cam\_femto\_display.v), sin CPU ni camara: listo}
\CommentTok{//   para OpenLane.}
\KeywordTok{module}\NormalTok{ sobel\_top }\OperatorTok{(}
    \DataTypeTok{input}  \DataTypeTok{wire}\NormalTok{       clk}\OperatorTok{,}
    \DataTypeTok{input}  \DataTypeTok{wire}\NormalTok{       reset}\OperatorTok{,}       \CommentTok{// sincrono, activo{-}alto}
    \DataTypeTok{input}  \DataTypeTok{wire}\NormalTok{       in\_valid}\OperatorTok{,}
    \DataTypeTok{input}  \DataTypeTok{wire} \OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{7}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{]}\NormalTok{ in\_pix}\OperatorTok{,}
    \DataTypeTok{input}  \DataTypeTok{wire} \OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{7}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{]}\NormalTok{ thr}\OperatorTok{,}         \CommentTok{// umbral de borde}
    \DataTypeTok{output} \DataTypeTok{reg}\NormalTok{        out\_valid}\OperatorTok{,}
    \DataTypeTok{output} \DataTypeTok{reg}  \OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{7}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{]}\NormalTok{ out\_pix      }\CommentTok{// 8\textquotesingle{}hFF borde / 8\textquotesingle{}h00 plano}
\OperatorTok{);}
    \CommentTok{// ventana 3x3 por line{-}buffers}
    \DataTypeTok{wire} \OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{7}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{]}\NormalTok{ w00}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{w01}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{w02}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ w10}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{w11}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{w12}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{ w20}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{w21}\OperatorTok{,}\NormalTok{w22}\OperatorTok{;}
    \DataTypeTok{wire}\NormalTok{       vin}\OperatorTok{;}
\NormalTok{    linebuf3x3 \#}\OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{.W}\OperatorTok{(}\DecValTok{60}\OperatorTok{),}\NormalTok{ .DW}\OperatorTok{(}\DecValTok{8}\OperatorTok{))}\NormalTok{ LB }\OperatorTok{(}
\NormalTok{        .clk}\OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{clk}\OperatorTok{),}\NormalTok{ .reset}\OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{reset}\OperatorTok{),}\NormalTok{ .in\_valid}\OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{in\_valid}\OperatorTok{),}\NormalTok{ .in\_pix}\OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{in\_pix}\OperatorTok{),}\NormalTok{ .valid\_o}\OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{vin}\OperatorTok{),}
\NormalTok{        .w00}\OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{w00}\OperatorTok{),}\NormalTok{.w01}\OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{w01}\OperatorTok{),}\NormalTok{.w02}\OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{w02}\OperatorTok{),}\NormalTok{ .w10}\OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{w10}\OperatorTok{),}\NormalTok{.w11}\OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{w11}\OperatorTok{),}\NormalTok{.w12}\OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{w12}\OperatorTok{),}
\NormalTok{        .w20}\OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{w20}\OperatorTok{),}\NormalTok{.w21}\OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{w21}\OperatorTok{),}\NormalTok{.w22}\OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{w22}\OperatorTok{));}

    \CommentTok{// Sobel 3x3: Gx/Gy con centro x2, magnitud Manhattan |Gx|+|Gy|}
    \DataTypeTok{wire} \OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{10}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{]}\NormalTok{ gxp }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ w02 }\OperatorTok{+} \OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{w12}\OperatorTok{\textless{}\textless{}}\DecValTok{1}\OperatorTok{)} \OperatorTok{+}\NormalTok{ w22}\OperatorTok{;}
    \DataTypeTok{wire} \OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{10}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{]}\NormalTok{ gxn }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ w00 }\OperatorTok{+} \OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{w10}\OperatorTok{\textless{}\textless{}}\DecValTok{1}\OperatorTok{)} \OperatorTok{+}\NormalTok{ w20}\OperatorTok{;}
    \DataTypeTok{wire} \OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{10}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{]}\NormalTok{ gyp }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ w20 }\OperatorTok{+} \OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{w21}\OperatorTok{\textless{}\textless{}}\DecValTok{1}\OperatorTok{)} \OperatorTok{+}\NormalTok{ w22}\OperatorTok{;}
    \DataTypeTok{wire} \OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{10}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{]}\NormalTok{ gyn }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ w00 }\OperatorTok{+} \OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{w01}\OperatorTok{\textless{}\textless{}}\DecValTok{1}\OperatorTok{)} \OperatorTok{+}\NormalTok{ w02}\OperatorTok{;}
    \DataTypeTok{wire} \OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{10}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{]}\NormalTok{ agx }\OperatorTok{=} \OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{gxp}\OperatorTok{\textgreater{}=}\NormalTok{gxn}\OperatorTok{)} \OperatorTok{?} \OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{gxp}\OperatorTok{{-}}\NormalTok{gxn}\OperatorTok{)} \OperatorTok{:} \OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{gxn}\OperatorTok{{-}}\NormalTok{gxp}\OperatorTok{);}
    \DataTypeTok{wire} \OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{10}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{]}\NormalTok{ agy }\OperatorTok{=} \OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{gyp}\OperatorTok{\textgreater{}=}\NormalTok{gyn}\OperatorTok{)} \OperatorTok{?} \OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{gyp}\OperatorTok{{-}}\NormalTok{gyn}\OperatorTok{)} \OperatorTok{:} \OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{gyn}\OperatorTok{{-}}\NormalTok{gyp}\OperatorTok{);}
    \DataTypeTok{wire} \OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{11}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{]}\NormalTok{ mag12 }\OperatorTok{=}\NormalTok{ agx }\OperatorTok{+}\NormalTok{ agy}\OperatorTok{;}
    \DataTypeTok{wire} \OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{7}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{]}\NormalTok{  mag }\OperatorTok{=} \OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{mag12 }\OperatorTok{\textgreater{}} \BaseNTok{12\textquotesingle{}d255}\OperatorTok{)} \OperatorTok{?} \BaseNTok{8\textquotesingle{}d255} \OperatorTok{:}\NormalTok{ mag12}\OperatorTok{[}\DecValTok{7}\OperatorTok{:}\DecValTok{0}\OperatorTok{];}

    \KeywordTok{always} \OperatorTok{@(}\KeywordTok{posedge}\NormalTok{ clk}\OperatorTok{)} \KeywordTok{begin}

\NormalTok{            out\_pix   }\OperatorTok{\textless{}=} \OperatorTok{(}\NormalTok{mag }\OperatorTok{\textgreater{}}\NormalTok{ thr}\OperatorTok{)} \OperatorTok{?} \BaseNTok{8\textquotesingle{}hFF} \OperatorTok{:} \BaseNTok{8\textquotesingle{}h00}\OperatorTok{;}
